notes: Same message records as at 2fe7c2d: type, id, timestamp, model, tokens {input, output, cached, thoughts, tool, total}.
Tokens usually arrive before the message is first written, as at 2fe7c2d, so the first copy of a message can already carry them; a later copy adds toolCalls. One call either way.
$patch lines (new since 2fe7c2d) rewrite content and tool results, remove ids or reorder them. They carry no tokens.
A $set line with messages is the legacy full-history checkpoint 2fe7c2d wrote; its messages were also appended one by one, so it adds no call.
A removed or rewound message was still a billed API call and is counted.
A subagent's session is chats/<parent session id>/<subagent session id>.jsonl with kind subagent.
A file name that collides gets an index: session-<time>-<n>-<id[:8]>.jsonl.
The last line of the main session is cut off part way and carries nothing.
uncached input = input - cached + tool; output = output + thoughts.
